definitions.gloss: new film; new movie; latest release
definitions.explanation: A recently produced or newly released film. Used to distinguish newly made movies from older or classic ones.

examples.japanese: ⟦{週末|しゅうまつ}→週末：03030_shuumatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{新作映画|しんさくえいが}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{観|み}→観る：22793_miru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}こう→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: Let's go see a new movie this weekend.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{監督|かんとく}→監督：00185_kantoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{新作映画|しんさくえいが}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧⟦{公開|こうかい}→公開：11665_koukai⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: That director's new film will be released next month.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{映画館|えいがかん}→映画館：01024_eigakan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{新作映画|しんさくえいが}⟦だけでなく→〜だけでなく：18373_dakedenaku⟧、⟦{名作|めいさく}→名作：11869_meisaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{再上映|さいじょうえい}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{行|おこな}っている→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: This theater not only shows new films but also re-screens classic works.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{新作|しんさく}→新作：09523_shinsaku⟧ (new work, new production) and ⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧ (movie, film). A straightforward and frequently used term in entertainment media, movie listings, and everyday conversation about going to the cinema.

The ⟦{新作|しんさく}→新作：09523_shinsaku⟧ element can be combined with other media types: ⟦{新作|しんさく}→新作：09523_shinsaku⟧⟦ゲーム→ゲーム：03842_geemu⟧ (new game), ⟦{新作|しんさく}→新作：09523_shinsaku⟧⟦アニメ→アニメ：01527_anime⟧ (new anime), ⟦{新作|しんさく}→新作：09523_shinsaku⟧⟦ドラマ→ドラマ：03867_dorama⟧ (new drama).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {新作映画|しんさくえいが}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{予告|よこく}→予告：08379_yokoku⟧: trailer for a new film
- {新作映画|しんさくえいが}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{公開|こうかい}→公開：11665_koukai⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧: a new film is released
- {新作映画|しんさくえいが}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{観|み}る→観る：22793_miru⟧: to watch a new movie
- ⟦{話題|わだい}→話題：03793_wadai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{新作映画|しんさくえいが}: a much-discussed new film

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {最新作|さいしんさく}: the latest work — emphasizes it being the very newest production
- {公開中|こうかいちゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧: currently showing film — focuses on current availability rather than newness
- ⟦{旧作|きゅうさく}→旧作：24147_kyuusaku⟧: older work — the opposite, referring to older productions
